name: STEP client — access to the local STEP Bible server

meta.purpose: STEP is the application's ONLY external data source. This component holds what the code READS (options) and what the code MUST ENFORCE (checks). Nothing else.
meta.what_is_here: Options + checks. Every option below is read by scripts/analytics/step_client.py at run time; every check is enforced by it. If a key here is not read by the code, it does not belong here.

what_is_not_here.rationale, history, known defects: step.md — the knowledge, not the configuration.
what_is_not_here.canon book order, HTML/span parsing, res: step_client.py — these are FACTS about STEP and the canon, not decisions anyone makes. Config holds choices; code holds facts.
what_is_not_here..env: NOT RELEVANT. Researcher ruling 2026-07-16: STEP is ALWAYS the local server, never the web. The connection is not environment-dependent, so it is settled here and read from here. No STEP value is read from the environment.

connection.note: ESV_th is the Tyndale-House TAGGED module — it carries the Strong's numbers and morphology the study depends on. Untagged ESV returns well-formed text with none of the evidence, and does not error. `check.step.up` probes for tagging, not just for a response.

apis.note: Verbatim routes. The code formats these; it does not compose them. `{version}` `{strong}` `{text}` `{range}` `{reference}` are the only placeholders.

search.masterSearch.text.note: DISCOVERY ONLY. An English-text hit is not an original-language occurrence, so this route may never produce a raw verse record — it may only propose Strong's numbers to investigate.

search.masterSearch.meanings.note: DISCOVERY ONLY. STEP's curated Related-words panel: terms whose MEANING relates to the word, regardless of how ESV renders them.

bible.getBibleText.status: NOT IMPLEMENTED — the route is recorded from prior work and is NOT verified against the server. It is addressed by reference rather than search, so it has no 60-cap. Do not use until probed.

limits.exclude_reason: H9xxx / G9xxx are STEP-internal grammar-particle codes, not used in verse tagging.

multi_code.status: RECONCILE — open since 2026-07-13; blocks Proverbs I2-closure
multi_code.effect: Every multi-code term is currently UNDER-PULLING. _resolved_strong returns vocabInfos[0] only, silently dropping lettered siblings (ruach H7307: kept H7307G/194, dropped H7307H/137 + H7307I/7).

options.gloss_head_union: union siblings whose gloss head (text before ':') matches the primary's; dedup by osisId
options.union_all: REJECTED — merges homonyms (H2502A 'to rescue' + H2502B 'to arm')
options.per_span_from_master: build the verse-record from the master span's own STEP code; defers to morphology, which is already the study's source of truth

include_related.note: Researcher ruling 2026-07-15: pulling a term's related terms is an OPTION, default off, and when on it uses the same methods and controls as a main term. When off, the named-but-not-pulled set must be recorded.

checks.when: before any STEP operation, every run
checks.on_fail: STOP and warn the researcher. Do not retry silently, do not degrade, do not proceed on partial data.
checks.authority: researcher ruling 2026-07-16: 'the code must always check that step is up, that is a rule, and stop if it is not up'
checks: REACHABLE — the local server answers within timeout_seconds
VERSION ACCEPTED — module.getInfo for the probe Strong's under the configured version returns a vocabInfo with no errorMessage

TAGGED — search.masterSearch.strong for the probe Strong's returns total >= expect_verse_total_min. This is the tagged/untagged discriminator: an untagged module answers a Strong's search with zero results, so a well-formed empty answer is the failure this catches.
checks.probe_note: H0430 (elohim, 'God') chosen as a stable, unambiguous, high-frequency tagged term. Change it here, not in code.

checks.when: every masterSearch query, at every depth
checks.on_fail: halt — a short count must never bank
checks.note: STEP under-returns silently and never errors. Coverage is proved by ARITHMETIC, never by having applied a pagination strategy. A missing total is a failure, not a pass.

checks.check: the sourcing API's `may_source` permits the entity being written
checks.note: search.masterSearch.text and .meanings have an empty may_source: they may never source a raw entity.

checks.check: all four components present and well-formed

components.term: code resolves; gloss, transliteration, language non-empty
components.related: related_words[] PRESENT — empty is a valid finding, ABSENT is not
components.verses: verses[] present, rows == total, every verse carries span_strong_match

checks.note: Absent vs empty: an empty related_words[] is a fact about the term; a missing related_words KEY is a fact about the fetch.
